synthesis.reproducibility: Piper has stochastic inference and this repository's synthesis entrypoint exposes no seed contract. Deterministic text and recipes alone do not guarantee byte-identical WAV. Future generation must pin generated PCM/WAV hashes, model/config hashes, exact Piper/ONNX Runtime versions, settings and sample rate; replay the same pinned PCM for comparisons. No stimulus audio is generated in the baseline.
synthesis.speech_source: Every speech segment, including overlap and echo, must use this entrypoint and its configured language voice. Silence/noise may be generated only as non-speech additions.
synthesis.mutation_policy: Do not modify production synthesis parameters, thresholds or model files to pass.

comparison.normalization: Unicode NFC, casefold, remove Unicode punctuation (P* category), collapse whitespace. Preserve accents, spoken repetitions and self-correction words. Do not translate, stem, reorder, semantically rewrite or remove fillers.
comparison.reference_policy: These are expected synthetic transcripts, not observed Vosk output. Native and HIL validation in later tasks may fail; do not rewrite references merely to match recognizer errors.
comparison.silence_reference: Empty expected transcript means no authoritative user turn. WER/CER have no reference denominator and are not applicable; false activation/dispatch remain measured.

threshold_reference.policy: Every applicable metric must resolve to the selected versioned profile; unresolved, uncalibrated mandatory acoustic thresholds block a pass.

execution_policy.local_only: No remote provider or external action. Deterministic fake backends may simulate task state; this is separate from acoustic evidence.
execution_policy.remote_allowed: Synthetic public content is eligible only when deployment privacy, provider and network policy explicitly permit it; this field is not authorization or a runner.
execution_policy.artifact_directory: Explicit ignored temporary directory selected before generation; audio and derived transcripts must remain there under bounded retention.
execution_policy.hil: Requires explicit PC output/input and target input/output identifiers, calibration, isolated generated-audio environment, monitoring/loopback disabled, unique content-free exchange marker, bounded duration, runaway-level/retrigger abort and cleanup.
execution_policy.baseline: Catalog recipes are specifications only; no runner, playback, capture, network call or later test task is implemented.
